title: On Telling the whole street before dark
subtitle: 人际沟通 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 人际沟通（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·人际沟通与交流）
meta: 主题语境：人际沟通（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·人际沟通与交流）　|　核心词汇：tell　|　正文 338 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 tell 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1961 the operator ① told the whole street before dark in public, and every trainee in the station said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three shifts on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the operator ② tells the whole street before dark in silence without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ tell the whole street before dark at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ told the whole street before dark before — a line in the log for June 1955 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Telling the whole street before dark in public, the operator said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the switch at the far screen, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ tell the two brothers apart in silence, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Tell the two brothers apart at once and never mention it again.

By 1968 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the log, and a new trainee from the next station ⑧ tells the two brothers apart in public every shift without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the screen, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ told the whole street before dark again when nobody else would.

⑩ To tell the whole street before dark, my mother said in 1973, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the station remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the station forgets, somebody tells the whole street before dark in silence again and somebody must tell the whole street before dark in public all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 告诉（一般过去式 told the whole street before dark：1961 年操作员头一回这样做，当着众人面）
B. v. 告诉（一般现在 tells the whole street before dark：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 告诉（不定式 to tell the whole street before dark：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 告诉（过去完成时 had told the whole street before dark：1955 年六月的运行日志上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 告诉（动名词 telling the whole street before dark 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 分辨（tell the two brothers apart：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去分辨把那两兄弟分辨出来）
G. v. 分辨（tell the two brothers apart：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 告诉（后段两处：新来的实习生照例 tells the two brothers apart，而母亲又一次 told the whole street before dark）

answers.why: tell 意为“告诉”，1961 年操作员当着众人面告诉天黑前告诉了整条街，那是机房里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 told。
tell 意为“告诉”，自那以后操作员一言不发地把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 tells。
tell 意为“告诉”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯告诉天黑前告诉了整条街”，此处为不定式 to tell the whole street before dark。
tell 意为“告诉”，运行日志里 六月 那行字说明早在 1968 年之前就有人告诉过，故用过去完成时 had told。
tell 意为“告诉”，操作员说“告诉天黑前告诉了整条街这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 telling the whole street before dark 作主语。
tell 意为“分辨”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去分辨把那两兄弟分辨出来”，should ever 之后用原形 tell the two brothers apart。
tell 意为“分辨”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻分辨把那两兄弟分辨出来（tell the two brothers apart at once），以后再也不要提起。
tell 意为“告诉”，新来的实习生每个班次都照例分辨把那两兄弟分辨出来，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 tells。
tell 意为“告诉”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次当着众人面告诉天黑前告诉了整条街，用一般过去式 told 叙述。
tell 意为“告诉”，结尾那句是母亲 1973 年的话：要告诉天黑前告诉了整条街，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和机房记住的那一件。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 tell 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1961 the operator told the whole street before dark in public, and nobody in the station forgot it.
Even now the operator tells the whole street before dark in silence whenever the station asks.
Telling the whole street before dark in public, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever tell the two brothers apart in silence, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new trainee from the next station tells the two brothers apart in public every shift, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother told the whole street before dark again, and the station remembered that half.
